#: Which MIDI ports the JSON examples should open. Keys starting with # are ignored, so this file documents itself. Every key is optional; delete this file and the defaults apply.
#1: Part of a port name, case insensitive. "nord" finds "Nord Piano 6 MIDI" and "Clavia Nord". The name wins over the numbers below.
#2: Port numbers used only when no name matched. -1 means 'do not fall back'. A number that names no port is an error here, not a quiet port 0.
#3: Multiplies every note's velocity on the way out. 1.0 leaves it alone; 0.5 is a quieter keyboard.
#4: MIDI channel to send on, 0..15, or leave it out to keep each message's own channel.
